About Gülermak

Established in Ankara in 1958, Gülermak has to date delivered nearly 400 kilometers of
tunnels, 120 underground metro stations, approximately 1,600 kilometers of railway and
high-speed rail (HSR) lines worldwide. The company has also been involved in the use and
operation of almost 60 tunnel boring machines. Leveraging its extensive expertise in
turnkey and EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction) models for metro and rail
systems, the Company has successfully completed and delivered more than 100 projects
mainly in Türkiye, Poland, Sweden, the UAE, India, and other international markets. Since
January 17, 2025, Gülermak’s shares have been traded on Borsa İstanbul’s Star Market
under the ticker GLRMK. Further information about Gülermak is available at
www.gulermak.com.tr.
